description: WARM build profiles against hnswlib builds on a GCP n2-standard-8 (8 vCPU Ice Lake, 4 physical cores), 8 build threads, nothing else running, builds interleaved, serving on one pinned core (cpu 2, HT sibling idle), 10 timed rounds. SIFT-1M: 5 build repeats; glove-100-angular: 1 build repeat (time cap). hnswlib 0.8.0, serving through the native C++ driver (benchmarks/competitive/hnswlib_cpp). Base: perf/build-time-and-memory (main 120ab9ff); bench/fair-harness and integrate/publication-fixes are not merged, so queries are not split into selection and report sets and recall points are read on the 10,000 test queries. WARM: public-bench ann-qgraph vertex index, degree 64, build_ef 500, quantized search (SIFT 8-bit codes rerank 32,64; glove 4-bit codes rerank 64). GCP numbers; the project timing host re-measures later.
